title: Zenith Realty
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

checks.browser: Chromium via playwright-core against production dist at the required subpath

asset_issues.asset: Supplied hero video and four property/service images
asset_issues.details: Initial Python direct-origin requests stalled and image proxy requests returned 403. Curl successfully downloaded the original MP4 and all four exact supplied Higgs WebP outputs. All load locally in both browser checks; no substitutions.
Google Fonts response provides 300, 400, 700, 900 with no separate 500 file. Local regular face is mapped to CSS weights 400–500; all requested styling weights remain in CSS.
The specified Zenith reference file was absent. Implemented from the complete written prompt; no reference extraction was needed.

notes: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, lucide-react, motion/react, and Recharts. No footer.
Original supplied text, property data, chart values, and capped bar shapes implemented.
Mobile chart intrinsic-width overflow discovered and fixed; final document widths are exactly 1440 and 390.
Forms validate locally and explicitly disclose that no data is submitted or stored. No backend was supplied.
Mortgage and Blog link to the investment section; Company links to services; Careers opens an introduction dialog.
Vite emits a non-blocking advisory for the 659.71 kB main JavaScript chunk.
Browser checks cover Chromium emulation, not Safari or physical devices. Video capture frames vary.
Ready means prepared for review. No deployment, push, agent spawning, or external messaging performed.
